notes.title: Demo version is already available!
notes.notes:
During the Steam Festival, you can play a demo version of our game. All brothers will have access to the prologue and the fool game. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a cozy chamber party, show everyone who is in charge here. Do not forget to help the author with nishtyaks and add the game to your wishlist. Soon there will be a full-fledged version of the game, where you can reveal all your talents!
